detailed_descriptions.en: Copperfell is a single-player scape-like adventure game built around character progression. Level up 24 different skills to unlock new resources and abilities. Craft powerful equipment using a combination of skilling recipes and rare monster loot. While inspired by old-school RPGs such as RuneScape, Copperfell is designed to respect your time. Skills don't take an excessive amount of time to level up, and don't require high intensity gameplay to train efficiently. Rare monster drop rates also improve with every kill, preventing long unlucky streaks. There’s more than one way to train each skill. Settle into repetitive training sessions, or take on orders to mix up your gameplay through crafting equipment, slaying monsters, or travelling the world while earning special rewards. Delve into the caves below, battling a wide variety of monsters for their unique drops. Combat is split between melee, shooting, and sorcery, each with multiple weapon types to master. Monsters have different weaknesses, rewarding you for switching your equipment to suit what you're fighting. Venture across a vast open world filled with distinct biomes, villages, settlements, and plenty of locations to discover. Meet Copperfell's inhabitants and help them through interactive quests with unique stories, puzzles, and a touch of humor. Completing quests will earn you experience across your skills while also uncovering new areas and unlocking unique items. Game Features 🗺️ Open world exploration across multiple realms and settlements ⚔️ Tactical combat with challenging boss fights 🪓 24 skills to grind and level up 🎣 Relaxing activities such as mining, woodcutting, farming, and fishing 🧙‍♂️ Humorous, story-rich questlines with memorable NPCs 🏡 Ability to build and customize your very own home A Work of Passion Everything in Copperfell beyond the underlying game engine was self-made, including the code, shaders, pixel art, animations, music, and even the fonts. Creative commons sounds were used for the sound effects. No generative AI was used in the creation of this game, and no 3rd party assets were used either. Free Demo Want to try Copperfell before buying? A free demo is available! It features a smaller world, with many higher tier monsters, items, quests, and activities reserved for the full game, and skills capped at level 50. But other than that, you're free to play for as long as you like, there are no time limits. Best of all, demo save files are fully compatible with the full game, so if you decide to purchase the game and continue your journey, you won't lose any of your progress. Whether you're looking to loot rare treasures, master your skills, or simply help out the people around you, the world of Copperfell is yours to shape.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Copperfell is a single-player scape-like adventure game built around character progression. Level up 24 different skills to unlock new resources and abilities. Craft powerful equipment using a combination of skilling recipes and rare monster loot.

While inspired by old-school RPGs such as RuneScape, Copperfell is designed to respect your time. Skills don't take an excessive amount of time to level up, and don't require high intensity gameplay to train efficiently. Rare monster drop rates also improve with every kill, preventing long unlucky streaks. There’s more than one way to train each skill. Settle into repetitive training sessions, or take on orders to mix up your gameplay through crafting equipment, slaying monsters, or travelling the world while earning special rewards.

Delve into the caves below, battling a wide variety of monsters for their unique drops. Combat is split between melee, shooting, and sorcery, each with multiple weapon types to master. Monsters have different weaknesses, rewarding you for switching your equipment to suit what you're fighting.

Venture across a vast open world filled with distinct biomes, villages, settlements, and plenty of locations to discover. Meet Copperfell's inhabitants and help them through interactive quests with unique stories, puzzles, and a touch of humor. Completing quests will earn you experience across your skills while also uncovering new areas and unlocking unique items.

Game Features

🗺️ Open world exploration across multiple realms and settlements

⚔️ Tactical combat with challenging boss fights

🪓 24 skills to grind and level up

🎣 Relaxing activities such as mining, woodcutting, farming, and fishing

🧙‍♂️ Humorous, story-rich questlines with memorable NPCs

🏡 Ability to build and customize your very own home

A Work of Passion

Everything in Copperfell beyond the underlying game engine was self-made, including the code, shaders, pixel art, animations, music, and even the fonts. Creative commons sounds were used for the sound effects. No generative AI was used in the creation of this game, and no 3rd party assets were used either.

Free Demo

Want to try Copperfell before buying? A free demo is available! It features a smaller world, with many higher tier monsters, items, quests, and activities reserved for the full game, and skills capped at level 50. But other than that, you're free to play for as long as you like, there are no time limits. Best of all, demo save files are fully compatible with the full game, so if you decide to purchase the game and continue your journey, you won't lose any of your progress.

Whether you're looking to loot rare treasures, master your skills, or simply help out the people around you, the world of Copperfell is yours to shape.
